jonson-works: The Works of Ben Jonson, with a biographical memoir by William Gifford, a new edition

jonson-works.evidence: Read title page; one-volume complete Works (plays, masques, poems).
jonson-works.case: Bloom asks for the poems, plays and masques together; Gifford's one-volume Routledge Works is the handiest complete text.
jonson-works.note: PG has many single plays (Volpone 4039, Alchemist 4081, etc.) and Discoveries+Poems (5134). Gifford/Cunningham 9-vol (1875) also on IA.
